penalty: integrated squared second derivative; iid ridge penalty remains separate for player effect
knots: no supplied knots; mgcv places 10 knots evenly through ordered training covariate values
heave_rule: retain all distances including 30-plus feet; no cap or winsorization
prediction_range_rule: stop before outcome access if a prediction distance is outside that split's training range
k_escalation_rule: refit once at k=20 only when distance EDF >= 0.95*(k-1) AND k-index < 0.9 AND p < 0.05; if still inadequate stop before validation
